   * **Tip:**  Don't let the soil dry out completely. Bush beans are heavy feeders and need consistent moisture to produce a good yield.  Water deeply and regularly, especially when the plants are flowering and forming

Okay, you're planning a countryside day hike – fantastic! It’s easy to get caught up in the excitement and focus on the big stuff like boots and water. But here are five essentials people often forget, that can really make a difference:
